message: You know that awkward moment when you realize you’ve never really thought about what to do if a fire breaks out at home? I’ve been there, and let me tell you, it’s a real knee-slapper when you think you’re prepared for everything—except the unexpected. This resource dives into some practical tips on home fire safety that can help us all avoid that "oops" moment. What’s one thing you’ve done to make your home safer?
